post.title: Stock futures did a U-turn after the midterms. Here's why
post.ig:
Dow futures sank overnight, then flipped up 724 points.
The AP projects Democrats will win both the House and the Senate after Tuesday's midterms.
Nasdaq 100 futures hit 27,616, their lowest since July 30, then bounced to 28,546 by 6:30 AM ET, about 930 points.
Solar, hospital stocks and gold rose premarket; Tesla, SpaceX and defense stocks fell. CNBC found the S&P 500 was higher a year after each of the last 11 midterms (1982-2022), but history isn't a promise.
Sources: CNBC, Associated Press, Fox Business (Nov 4, 2026).
